name: Developer
description: Space-dark developer portfolio with a real 3D keyboard floating in a star-field — thin gradient display type, blur-in reveals, a timeline of experience, screenshot project cards with a detail modal, an elastic cursor, and buttery smooth scroll.
designNotes: The Developer template — 'Spacebar' — reimagines an engineer's portfolio as a moment in deep space, on a near-black navy field lit by a single violet glow and a sky-blue counter-glow, behind a mouse-parallax canvas star-field. Archivo Black carries the huge thin gradient hero name and section titles; Inter sets the prose; JetBrains Mono is reserved for eyebrows, dates and the loading readout. Content arrives through a preloader (simulated progress + slide-up reveal) and then blur-in / box-reveal scroll animations. The Tech Stack section IS an interactive 3D mechanical keyboard: every one of the portfolio owner's skills becomes a pressable keycap on a perspective-tilted deck (Font Awesome brand glyph or a mono abbreviation, colour-cycled per category). Pressing a key — by click, tap, or a physical keystroke — plays a synthesized mechanical click (Web Audio, no audio asset; muteable and remembered in localStorage) and shows the skill name in a live readout; on desktop the deck tilts with a pointer-parallax. Experience is a rail-and-node timeline of cards; projects are screenshot cards that open a detail modal with metrics, tech badges, a gallery and links. A floating pill nav with scrollspy and an elastic, velocity-stretched cursor complete the feel. The keyboard is pure CSS 3D + Web Audio with NO external runtime or CDN, so it renders on locked-down networks and stays interactive (just un-floated) under reduced-motion — fixing the prior Spline scene that silently vanished when a CDN was blocked or reduced-motion was on. Design language adapted from Naresh Khatri's open-source 3D portfolio, credited in the footer.
